notes: Shutdown closes public operation admission before stopping external intake and background producers.
Final consumer disposal waits for every previously admitted operation to finish or settle cancellation.
Setup cannot publish another graph during construction or teardown. After shutdown completes, a fresh setup is allowed.
Concurrent shutdown waiters join one teardown; cancelling a waiter does not cancel teardown.
Platform APIs may expose separate initiation and completion methods. Android shutdown initiates without blocking; shutdownAndAwait awaits completion.
